## InfoTB v0.4.0

### Added
- Android route map for transit lines, with selectable stops and arrival details.
- Nearby stops on line pages, with configurable distance and stop count.
- Recent line news on line pages, with a **Read** action to dismiss notices.
- Nearest saved stop selection for the home-screen widget.

### Improved
- Android location lookup tries available location providers and reports when permission or location services need attention.
- Android maps disappear cleanly when navigating to another page.
- Arrival time badges and `Next` / `Urm.` labels line up more consistently across platforms.
- Home-screen widget data is written to the shared container before its timeline reloads.

### iOS sideloading note
The widget requires the signing tool to grant the same App Group to the app and widget extension. The Signulous-signed IPA tested for this release omitted the app's configured group, so the widget-sharing warning remains on that installation. See [iOS sideloading](https://github.com/dev-andrei-v/infotb-modern-client/blob/v0.4.0/docs/building.md#ios-sideloading).
